-- ASTA BACK v18
-- أوتو هولد: يلف حول الخصم بمسافة طبيعية عشان ما يقدر ياخد القنبلة،
-- ولما يوصل العداد لـ "وقت الهولد" يروح للخصم ويسلّمه (ويلف حول الحواف والجدران لو قدامه).
-- يتعرف تلقائي على اللي معك بالقيم (اللون الأخضر = معك) ويتجاهلهم.
-- زر "لف الشاشة": الشاشة تلف حولك بهدوء (طبيعي) واللاعب يبقى بنص الشاشة.
-- فيديو مقدمة + دخولية + كلمة سر (ASTA1) + قائمة فخمة بخلفية انمي.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
local GUI_NAME = "AstaBackGui"
local SAVE_FILE = "ASTA_BACK.json"
local CAM_BIND = "AstaBackCam"

-- ================= إعدادات الحركة =================
local ORBIT_RADIUS = 7        -- مسافة الدوران عن الخصم
local RADIUS_WOBBLE = 1       -- تذبذب بسيط بالمسافة
local ORBIT_LEAD = 0.5        -- سرعة الدوران العادي (أكبر = أسرع)
local SPIN_LEAD = 0.7         -- سرعة الدوران لما "لف الشاشة" شغال
local FLEE_DIST = 4.5         -- لو الخصم قرب أقل من هذي المسافة يبتعد عنه
local CHASE_DIST = 3          -- لو هرب أبعد من (المسافة + هذا) يلحقه
local MAX_RANGE = 90          -- أقصى مسافة يشوف فيها الخصم
local HIT_RANGE = 6.5         -- المسافة اللي يضغط عندها وقت التسليم
local PREDICT = 0.35          -- يتوقع مكان الخصم بعد كم ثانية

-- ================= إعدادات لفة الشاشة =================
local SPIN_SPEED = 2.2        -- سرعة لفة الشاشة (راديان بالثانية، 6.28 = لفة كاملة بالثانية) - كل ما قلّ الرقم صارت أهدى

local MAX_TIME = 10           -- أقصى وقت هولد؛ لو زاد يرجع لـ 1

-- ================= الإعدادات =================
local settings = {attackTime = 2}
pcall(function()
    if isfile and readfile and isfile(SAVE_FILE) then
        local data = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(SAVE_FILE))
        if type(data.attackTime) == "number" then
            settings.attackTime = math.clamp(math.floor(data.attackTime), 1, MAX_TIME)
        end
    end
end)
local function saveSettings()
    pcall(function()
        if writefile then writefile(SAVE_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode(settings)) end
    end)
end

-- ================= الواجهة =================
local function getParent()
    local ok, ui = pcall(function() return gethui and gethui() end)
    if ok and ui then return ui end
    local ok2, core = pcall(function() return game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
    if ok2 and core then return core end
    return lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

local parent = getParent()
local old = parent:FindFirstChild(GUI_NAME)
if old then old:Destroy() end
local pg = lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
if pg and pg:FindFirstChild(GUI_NAME) then pg[GUI_NAME]:Destroy() end
pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(CAM_BIND) end)

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = GUI_NAME
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.DisplayOrder = 999
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.Parent = parent

local RED = Color3.fromRGB(235, 60, 70)
local GREEN = Color3.fromRGB(70, 220, 130)
local BG = Color3.fromRGB(10, 8, 24)
local CARD = Color3.fromRGB(22, 17, 44)
local GOLD = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 130)
local PINK = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 190)
local PURPLE = Color3.fromRGB(150, 110, 255)
local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

local function mk(class, props, parent)
    local o = Instance.new(class)
    for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
    if parent then o.Parent = parent end
    return o
end
local function corner(o, r)
    return mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r)}, o)
end
-- إطار متدرج الألوان (فخم)
local function luxStroke(parent, thick)
    local st = mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = thick, Color = WHITE, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, parent)
    local gr = mk("UIGradient", {Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, PURPLE), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, PINK), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, GOLD)})}, st)
    return st, gr
end
local function goldText(label)
    return mk("UIGradient", {Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, GOLD), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, WHITE), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, GOLD)})}, label)
end

        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then

        TweenService:Create(sc, TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Scale = 1}):Play()

-- ================= الحالة =================
local active = false
local locked = false
local autoSpin = false          -- لف الشاشة (افتراضي مطفي)

local LANG = "ar"
local STR = {
    ar = {on = "هولد نشط 🔥", off = "⚡ هولد: مغلق", time = "وقت الهولد: ", spinOn = "🔄 لف الشاشة: شغال", spinOff = "🔄 لف الشاشة: مطفي"},
    en = {on = "Hold ACTIVE 🔥", off = "⚡ Hold: OFF", time = "Hold time: ", spinOn = "🔄 Spin screen: ON", spinOff = "🔄 Spin screen: OFF"},
}

local function refreshUi()
    if active then
        toggleBtn.Text = STR[LANG].on
        toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(176, 36, 86)
        toggleBtn.TextColor3 = WHITE
        statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = GREEN
    else
        toggleBtn.Text = STR[LANG].off
        toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = CARD
        toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 200)
        statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = RED
    end
    timeLabel.Text = STR[LANG].time .. tostring(settings.attackTime)
    if autoSpin then
        spinBtn.Text = STR[LANG].spinOn
        spinBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 255, 180)
    else
        spinBtn.Text = STR[LANG].spinOff
        spinBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 150)
    end
    lockBtn.Text = locked and "🔒" or "🔓"
    lockBtn.BackgroundTransparency = locked and 0.6 or 0.86
end

-- ================= كشف اللي معك تلقائي (الأخضر = معك) =================
local greenSet, greenAt = {}, -10

local function isGreen(c)
    if typeof(c) ~= "Color3" then return false end
    local h, s, v = Color3.toHSV(c)
    return h >= 0.19 and h <= 0.47 and s >= 0.35 and v >= 0.35
end

-- هل هذا العنصر علامة خضراء ظاهرة؟ (هايلايت / إطار / نص / صورة / مربع)
local function greenMark(d)
    local ok, res = pcall(function()
        if d:IsA("Highlight") then
            return d.Enabled and ((isGreen(d.FillColor) and d.FillTransparency < 0.95)
                or (isGreen(d.OutlineColor) and d.OutlineTransparency < 0.95))
        elseif d:IsA("GuiBase3d") then
            return d.Visible and d.Transparency < 0.95 and isGreen(d.Color3)
        elseif d:IsA("UIStroke") then
            return d.Enabled and d.Transparency < 0.9 and isGreen(d.Color)
        elseif d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") then
            return d.Visible and d.TextTransparency < 0.9 and isGreen(d.TextColor3)
        elseif d:IsA("ImageLabel") or d:IsA("ImageButton") then
            return d.Visible and d.ImageTransparency < 0.9 and d.Image ~= "" and isGreen(d.ImageColor3)
        elseif d:IsA("Frame") then
            return d.Visible and d.BackgroundTransparency < 0.9 and isGreen(d.BackgroundColor3)
        end
        return false
    end)
    return ok and res == true
end

-- اللاعب اللي هذا العنصر تابع لجسمه
local function ownerOf(inst)
    local m = inst
    while m do
        if m:IsA("Model") then
            local pl = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m)
            if pl then return pl end
        end
        m = m.Parent
    end
    return nil
end

-- لو الصورة هي وجه لاعب (بالواجهة فوق مثلاً)
local function hudOwner(img)
    local s = img.Image
    if s == "" then return nil end
    s = " " .. s .. " "
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= lp and s:find("%D" .. p.UserId .. "%D") then return p end
    end
    return nil
end

local function ringGreen(img)
    for _, o in ipairs({img, img.Parent}) do
        if o and o:IsA("GuiObject") then
            if greenMark(o) then return true end
            for _, c in ipairs(o:GetChildren()) do
                if c:IsA("UIStroke") and greenMark(c) then return true end
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

local BB_CLASSES = {UIStroke = true, TextLabel = true, TextButton = true, ImageLabel = true, ImageButton = true, Frame = true}

local function refreshGreen()
    greenAt = os.clock()
    local found = {}

    -- 1) علامات على جسم اللاعب نفسه
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= lp and p.Character then
            for _, d in ipairs(p.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("Highlight") or d:IsA("GuiBase3d") then
                    if greenMark(d) then found[p] = true break end
                elseif BB_CLASSES[d.ClassName] and d:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BillboardGui") and greenMark(d) then
                    found[p] = true break
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- 2) علامات برا الجسم (هايلايت/مربعات داخل workspace أو الكاميرا)
    local function scanLoose(list)
        for _, d in ipairs(list) do
            if d:IsA("Highlight") or d:IsA("GuiBase3d") or d:IsA("BillboardGui") then
                local tgt = d.Parent
                pcall(function() tgt = d.Adornee or d.Parent end)
                local own = tgt and ownerOf(tgt)
                if own and own ~= lp and not found[own] then
                    if d:IsA("BillboardGui") then
                        for _, x in ipairs(d:GetDescendants()) do
                            if BB_CLASSES[x.ClassName] and greenMark(x) then found[own] = true break end
                        end
                    elseif greenMark(d) then
                        found[own] = true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    scanLoose(workspace:GetChildren())
    if workspace.CurrentCamera then scanLoose(workspace.CurrentCamera:GetChildren()) end

    -- 3) واجهة اللعبة: لافتات فوق اللاعبين + أيقونات/أسماء الفريق فوق
    local pgui = lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    if pgui then
        for _, d in ipairs(pgui:GetDescendants()) do
            if not d:IsDescendantOf(gui) then
                local cn = d.ClassName
                if cn == "BillboardGui" then
                    local own = d.Adornee and ownerOf(d.Adornee)
                    if own and own ~= lp and not found[own] then
                        for _, x in ipairs(d:GetDescendants()) do
                            if BB_CLASSES[x.ClassName] and greenMark(x) then found[own] = true break end
                        end
                    end
                elseif cn == "ImageLabel" or cn == "ImageButton" then
                    local own = hudOwner(d)
                    if own and not found[own] and ringGreen(d) then found[own] = true end
                elseif cn == "TextLabel" and d.Text ~= "" and isGreen(d.TextColor3) and d.Visible then
                    local t = d.Text:lower()
                    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                        if p ~= lp and not found[p] and (t == p.Name:lower() or t == p.DisplayName:lower()) then
                            found[p] = true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- لو الكل طلع أخضر معناها الأخضر مو علامة للي معك، نتجاهلها
    local others, greens = 0, 0
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= lp then
            others += 1
            if found[p] then greens += 1 end
        end
    end
    if others > 0 and greens == others then found = {} end
    greenSet = found
end

-- فرق روبلوكس العادية
local function autoTeammate(p)
    local myTeam = lp.Team
    if myTeam and p.Team == myTeam then return true end
    if lp.Neutral == false and p.Neutral == false and p.TeamColor == lp.TeamColor then
        return true
    end
    for _, name in ipairs({"Team", "TeamName", "team"}) do
        local a, b = lp:GetAttribute(name), p:GetAttribute(name)
        if a ~= nil and a == b then return true end
        local ca = lp.Character and lp.Character:GetAttribute(name)
        local cb = p.Character and p.Character:GetAttribute(name)
        if ca ~= nil and ca == cb then return true end
    end
    local function teamValue(plr)
        local v = plr:FindFirstChild("Team") or plr:FindFirstChild("TeamName")
        if v and v:IsA("ValueBase") then return v.Value end
        local ls = plr:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
        local lv = ls and (ls:FindFirstChild("Team") or ls:FindFirstChild("TeamName"))
        if lv and lv:IsA("ValueBase") then return lv.Value end
        return nil
    end
    local ta, tb = teamValue(lp), teamValue(p)
    if ta ~= nil and ta == tb then return true end
    return false
end

local function isTeammate(p)
    if autoTeammate(p) then return true end
    if os.clock() - greenAt > 0.8 then pcall(refreshGreen) end
    return greenSet[p] == true
end

toggleBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
    active = not active
    refreshUi()
end)
minusBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
    settings.attackTime = math.max(settings.attackTime - 1, 1)
    saveSettings()
    refreshUi()
end)
plusBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
    -- أقصى شي 10، لو زاد يرجع لـ 1
    if settings.attackTime >= MAX_TIME then
        settings.attackTime = 1
    else
        settings.attackTime = settings.attackTime + 1
    end
    saveSettings()
    refreshUi()
end)
spinBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
    autoSpin = not autoSpin
    refreshUi()
end)
lockBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
    locked = not locked
    refreshUi()
end)
refreshUi()

-- السحب (ما يشتغل لو القائمة مثبتة)
do
    local dragging, dragStart, startPos = false, nil, nil
    local function begin(input)
        if locked then return end
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = frame.Position
            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
            end)
        end
    end
    frame.InputBegan:Connect(begin)
    title.InputBegan:Connect(begin)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not dragging then return end
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            local d = input.Position - dragStart
            frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X,
                startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
        end
    end)
end

local B64 = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local B64MAP = {}
for i = 1, 64 do B64MAP[B64:byte(i)] = i - 1 end
local function b64decode(data, anyBin)
    for _, fn in ipairs({
        function() return crypt.base64decode(data) end,
        function() return crypt.base64.decode(data) end,
        function() return base64_decode(data) end,
        function() return base64.decode(data) end,
    }) do
        local ok, res = pcall(fn)
        if ok and type(res) == "string" and #res > 100 and (anyBin or res:byte(1) == 255) then return res end
    end
    data = data:gsub("%s", "")
    local out = {}
    for i = 1, #data, 4 do
        local a, b, c, d = data:byte(i, i + 3)
        local n = B64MAP[a] * 262144 + B64MAP[b] * 4096 + (B64MAP[c] or 0) * 64 + (B64MAP[d] or 0)
        local piece = string.char(math.floor(n / 65536) % 256, math.floor(n / 256) % 256, n % 256)
        if not B64MAP[c] then piece = piece:sub(1, 1) elseif not B64MAP[d] then piece = piece:sub(1, 2) end
        out[#out + 1] = piece
        if i % 40000 == 1 then task.wait() end
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end

local function success()
    if busy then return end
    busy = true
    errLabel.TextColor3 = GREEN
    errLabel.Text = "✅ تم الدخول بنجاح"
    boxStroke.Color = GREEN
    task.wait(0.5)
    -- اختيار اللغة
    TweenService:Create(cardG, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {GroupTransparency = 1}):Play()
    task.wait(0.35)
    cardG.Visible = false
    local chosen
    local langCard = mk("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = CARD_POS, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(250, 150),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 10, 34), BackgroundTransparency = 0.1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 62}, gate)
    corner(langCard, 14)
    luxStroke(langCard, 2)
    local lt = mk("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 10), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22),
        Text = "🌐 اختر اللغة  |  Choose language", TextColor3 = WHITE, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextSize = 13, ZIndex = 63}, langCard)
    goldText(lt)
    for i, opt in ipairs({{"ar", "العربية"}, {"en", "English"}}) do
        local b = mk("TextButton", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 40 + (i - 1) * 50), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(210, 38), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
            AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 63}, langCard)
        corner(b, 10)
        mk("UIGradient", {Rotation = 0, Color = ColorSequence.new(PURPLE, PINK)}, b)
        mk("TextLabel", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = opt[2], TextColor3 = WHITE,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextSize = 16, ZIndex = 64}, b)
        b.Activated:Connect(function() chosen = opt[1] end)
    end
    while not chosen do task.wait(0.05) end
    LANG = chosen
    pcall(refreshUi)
    langCard:Destroy()
    local ti = TweenInfo.new(0.7, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
    TweenService:Create(cardG, ti, {GroupTransparency = 1}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(logo, ti, {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(logoStroke, ti, {Transparency = 1}):Play()

    task.wait(0.75)
    pcall(function() petalConn:Disconnect() end)

    local finalPos = UDim2.new(1, -210, 0.3, 0)

local function fail()
    errLabel.TextColor3 = RED
    errLabel.Text = "❌ خطأ: كلمة السر غلط"
    boxStroke.Color = RED
    box.Text = ""
    task.spawn(function()
        for i = 1, 8 do
            cardG.Position = CARD_POS + UDim2.fromOffset((i % 2 == 0 and -1 or 1) * (10 - i), 0)
            task.wait(0.035)
        end
        cardG.Position = CARD_POS
        task.wait(0.6)
        boxStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(110, 90, 200)
    end)
end

local function tryLogin()
    if not introDone or busy then return end
    local txt = box.Text:gsub("^%s+", "")
    txt = txt:gsub("%s+$", "")
    if txt == PASSWORD then
        success()
    else
        fail()
    end
end
loginBtn.Activated:Connect(tryLogin)
box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter) if enter then tryLogin() end end)

    local p = imgs.panel or imgs.bg
    if p then panelImg.Image = p end
    if imgs.bg and gate.Parent then
        gateBg.Image = imgs.bg

    end
end

    pcall(function()
        local asset = getcustomasset or getsynasset
        if IMG_ID > 0 then
            imgs.bg = "rbxassetid://" .. IMG_ID
            imgs.panel = imgs.bg
        end
        if asset and writefile then
            if IMG_URL ~= "" then
                pcall(function()
                    writefile("asta_back_custom.png", game:HttpGet(IMG_URL))
                    imgs.bg = asset("asta_back_custom.png")
                    imgs.panel = imgs.bg
                end)
            end
            for key, file in pairs({bg = "asta_back_bg.jpg", panel = "asta_back_panel.jpg", avatar = "asta_back_avatar.jpg"}) do
                if not imgs[key] then
                    pcall(function()
                        writefile(file, b64decode(ASSETS[key]))
                        imgs[key] = asset(file)
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    pcall(applyImages)
end)

    pcall(function() skipBtn.Visible = false screen.Visible = false end)
    pcall(function() TweenService:Create(introVideo, TweenInfo.new(0.4), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play() end)

    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        local asset = getcustomasset or getsynasset
        assert(asset and writefile, "executor لا يدعم الملفات")
        local list = {}
        for chunk in ASSETS.frames:gmatch("[^;]+") do list[#list + 1] = chunk end
        local labels = {}
        -- فك الصور في الخلفية، والمقدمة تبدأ فورًا
        task.spawn(function()
            pcall(function()
                for i, chunk in ipairs(list) do
                    if videoDone then return end
                    local fname = string.format("asta17_f_%03d.jpg", i)
                    writefile(fname, b64decode(chunk, true))
                    labels[i] = mk("ImageLabel", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = asset(fname),
                        ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch, Visible = false, ZIndex = 202}, screen)
                    if i % 8 == 0 then task.wait() end
                end
            end)
        end)
        task.spawn(function()
            pcall(function()
                writefile("asta16_intro.mp3", b64decode(ASSETS.audio, true))
                if videoDone then return end
                introSound = Instance.new("Sound")
                introSound.SoundId = asset("asta16_intro.mp3")
                introSound.Volume = 1
                introSound.Parent = gui
                introSound:Play()
            end)
        end)
        while not labels[1] and not videoDone do task.wait() end
        local start, last, total = os.clock(), 0, #list
        while not videoDone do
            local idx = math.floor((os.clock() - start) * INTRO_FPS) + 1
            if idx > total then break end
            if labels[idx] and idx ~= last then
                if labels[last] then labels[last].Visible = false end
                labels[idx].Visible = true
                last = idx
            end
            RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
        end
        task.spawn(finishVideo)
    end)
    if not ok then
        warn("[ASTA BACK] intro failed: " .. tostring(err))
        task.spawn(finishVideo)
    end
end)

-- ================= المنطق =================
local rng = Random.new()

local function getTool(char)
    for _, item in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if item:IsA("Tool") then return item end
    end
    return nil
end

-- عداد القنبلة: الرقم اللي يظهر فوق راسك
local function readTimer(char)
    for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("TextLabel") and d.Visible then
            local g = d:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BillboardGui")
            if g and g.Enabled then
                local num = d.Text:match("^%s*(%d+%.?%d*)%s*$")
                if num then return tonumber(num) end
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function nearestEnemy(root)
    local best, bd = nil, MAX_RANGE
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= lp and not isTeammate(p) then
            local ch = p.Character
            local tr = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local th = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if tr and th and th.Health > 0 then
                local d = (tr.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                if d < bd then best, bd = tr, d end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local state = {
    target = nil, since = 0, dir = 1, nextSwap = 0, lastFlip = 0, lastHit = 0,
    spin = 0,             -- لفة الشاشة الحالية (راديان)
    spinVel = 0,          -- سرعة اللفة الحالية (تزيد بنعومة)
    holding = false,      -- true وانت ماسك القنبلة وشغّال
    camBound = false,
    wps = nil, wpIdx = 2, nextPath = 0, computing = false, nextFilter = 0,
}

local function wrapPi(a)
    return (a + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi
end

-- ================= كشف الجدران والمسار =================
local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

local function refreshFilter()
    local list = {}
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p.Character then table.insert(list, p.Character) end
    end
    rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = list
end

-- هل الطريق المباشر خالي؟ (نفحص بارتفاعين عشان نشوف الحواف الواطية بعد)
local function clearLine(from, to)
    for _, yOff in ipairs({0, -2}) do
        local origin = Vector3.new(from.X, from.Y + yOff, from.Z)
        local dest = Vector3.new(to.X, from.Y + yOff, to.Z)
        for _ = 1, 4 do
            local dir = dest - origin
            if dir.Magnitude < 0.5 then break end
            local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, dir, rayParams)
            if not hit then break end
            if hit.Instance.CanCollide then return false end
            origin = hit.Position + dir.Unit * 0.1
        end
    end
    return true
end

local function requestPath(fromPos, dest)
    if state.computing then return end
    state.computing = true
    task.spawn(function()
        local ok, path = pcall(function()
            local p = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
                AgentRadius = 2.5, AgentHeight = 5, AgentCanJump = true, WaypointSpacing = 4,
            })
            p:ComputeAsync(fromPos, dest)
            return p
        end)
        if ok and path and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
            state.wps = path:GetWaypoints()
            state.wpIdx = 2
        else
            state.wps = nil
        end
        state.computing = false
    end)
end

-- يمشي للنقطة؛ لو في جدار بالطريق يلف من الجنب بمسار
local function walkTo(hum, root, dest, now)
    local from = root.Position
    if clearLine(from, dest) then
        state.wps = nil
        hum:MoveTo(Vector3.new(dest.X, from.Y, dest.Z))
        return
    end
    if now >= state.nextPath then
        state.nextPath = now + 0.35
        requestPath(from, dest)
    end
    local wps = state.wps
    if wps then
        local wp = wps[state.wpIdx]
        while wp do
            local dx, dz = wp.Position.X - from.X, wp.Position.Z - from.Z
            if math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz) < 3 then
                state.wpIdx += 1
                wp = wps[state.wpIdx]
            else
                break
            end
        end
        if wp then
            hum:MoveTo(wp.Position)
            if wp.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then hum.Jump = true end
            return
        end
    end
    hum:MoveTo(Vector3.new(dest.X, from.Y, dest.Z))
end

-- ================= الكاميرا =================
-- الكاميرا العادية (عليك وتلفها بإيدك)، ونضيف فوقها لفة مستمرة وسريعة حولك مثل الفيديو.
local function unbindCam()
    if state.camBound then
        state.camBound = false
        pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(CAM_BIND) end)
    end
end

local function camStep(dt)
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local char = lp.Character
    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not (cam and root) then
        state.spin = 0
        unbindCam()
        return
    end

    if state.holding and autoSpin then
        -- تسارع بنعومة + تغيّر بسيط بالسرعة عشان يطلع طبيعي
        local target = state.dir * SPIN_SPEED * (1 + 0.1 * math.sin(os.clock() * 1.4))
        state.spinVel = state.spinVel + (target - state.spinVel) * math.min(1, dt * 5)
        state.spin = wrapPi(state.spin + state.spinVel * dt)
    else
        -- نرجّع اللفة بنعومة بدل ما تنقفز الشاشة
        state.spinVel = 0
        state.spin = state.spin * math.exp(-dt * 14)
        if math.abs(state.spin) < 0.01 then
            state.spin = 0
            unbindCam()
            return
        end
    end

    if state.spin ~= 0 then
        local pivot = CFrame.new(root.Position)
        cam.CFrame = pivot * CFrame.Angles(0, state.spin, 0) * pivot:Inverse() * cam.CFrame
    end
end

local function bindCam()
    if state.camBound then return end
    state.camBound = true
    RunService:BindToRenderStep(CAM_BIND, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, camStep)
end

local function stopHolding()
    state.holding = false
    state.wps = nil
end

-- ================= الحلقة الرئيسية =================
local conn
conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not gui.Parent then
        conn:Disconnect()
        stopHolding()
        return
    end
    if not authed or not active then
        state.target = nil
        stopHolding()
        return
    end

    local now = os.clock()

    local char = lp.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not (hum and root and hum.Health > 0) then
        state.target = nil
        stopHolding()
        return
    end

    local tool = getTool(char)
    if not tool then          -- ما معك القنبلة: ما نسوي شي
        state.target = nil
        stopHolding()
        return
    end

    if now >= state.nextFilter then
        state.nextFilter = now + 1
        refreshFilter()
    end

    local target = nearestEnemy(root)
    if target ~= state.target then
        state.target = target
        state.since = now
        state.wps = nil
    end
    if not target then
        stopHolding()
        return
    end
    if now - state.since < 0.08 then return end   -- رد فعل بسيط

    state.holding = true
    if autoSpin then bindCam() end

    local timer = readTimer(char)
    local deliver = (timer == nil) or (timer <= settings.attackTime)

    local dist = (target.Position - root.Position).Magnitude

    if deliver then
        -- تسليم: نروح للخصم (نلف حول الجدران لو في) ونضغط لما نقرب
        walkTo(hum, root, target.Position, now)
        if dist <= HIT_RANGE and now - state.lastHit >= 0.1 then
            state.lastHit = now
            pcall(function() tool:Activate() end)
        end
        return
    end

    -- ===== دوران طبيعي حول الخصم =====
    local vel = target.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    local predicted = target.Position + Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z) * PREDICT

    local rel = root.Position - predicted
    local ang = math.atan2(rel.Z, rel.X)

    -- يغيّر الاتجاه نادراً
    if now > state.nextSwap then
        if state.nextSwap ~= 0 and rng:NextNumber(0, 1) > 0.65 then
            state.dir = -state.dir
        end
        state.nextSwap = now + rng:NextNumber(5, 10)
    end

    -- مسافة تتذبذب بنعومة
    local r = ORBIT_RADIUS + math.sin(now * 0.9) * RADIUS_WOBBLE

    -- لو الخصم قرب: نبعد أكثر
    if dist < FLEE_DIST then
        r = r + (FLEE_DIST - dist) * 1.5
    end

    local lead = autoSpin and SPIN_LEAD or ORBIT_LEAD
    local function pointFor(d, l)
        local a = ang + d * l
        return predicted + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * r, 0, math.sin(a) * r)
    end

    local point
    if dist > r + CHASE_DIST then
        -- الخصم هرب: نلحقه لين نرجع على مسافة الدوران
        point = pointFor(state.dir, 0.25)
        walkTo(hum, root, point, now)
        return
    end

    point = pointFor(state.dir, lead)
    -- لو الجدار قدامك بنفس الاتجاه، نجرّب الاتجاه الثاني
    if not clearLine(root.Position, point) and now - state.lastFlip > 0.5 then
        local other = pointFor(-state.dir, lead)
        if clearLine(root.Position, other) then
            state.dir = -state.dir
            state.lastFlip = now
            point = other
        end
    end
    walkTo(hum, root, point, now)
end)

gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
    stopHolding()
    state.spin = 0
    state.spinVel = 0
    unbindCam()
end)

print("[ASTA BACK v18] Loaded")
